title: Enter the Event — RMB UTCT 2026 entry page
claims: The RMB UTCT entry page lists 2026 fees of R6,195 for the 100 miler, R5,195 for UT100, R3,755 for the 55 km, R2,655 for the 35 km, R955 for the 23 km and R1,595 for the 16 km.
The entry page's cancellation table offers a 60% refund before 1 July, 50% from 2 July to 1 September, 40% from 2 September to 1 October, 30% from 2 October to 31 October and 0% from 1 November.

Substitutions are allowed from 1 October to 1 November with a R250 admin fee; no deferrals are accepted except for pregnancy with a doctor's certificate, valid for one year and submitted by 2 November.
Downgrades are allowed before 3 November with no partial refund; upgrades are allowed before 3 November if the race is not sold out, paying the difference.
International elites with an ITRA performance index above 800 for men or above 690 for women can request a free entry; South African elites are handled case by case.
Race categories are solo Open 18-39, Vets 40-49, Masters 50+ and Grand Masters 60+.

verification.note: Official entry page read directly. The top says ENTRIES OPEN 26 FEBRUARY 2026 but the embedded terms paragraph still names 17–23 November 2025, so the fee table is treated as the current 2026 page while the refund/substitution clauses are recorded as page text needing confirmation in the 2026 entry email.
